description_en: Queries the information about the classification and grading template associated with an instance
description_zh: 使用此API获取实例绑定的分类分级模板信息，包含模板ID、模板类型等信息
name: GetClassificationTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户的ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

ClassificationResourceTemplateMap.description_en: The information about the classification template that is associated to the instance
ClassificationResourceTemplateMap.description_zh: 实例绑定的分类分级模板信息

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the resource. The supported resource type is INSTANCE. The resource ID corresponds to the value of InstanceId. You can call the [ListInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html） operation to obtain the value of InstanceId
ResourceId.description_zh: 资源ID。目前支持的资源类型为INSTANCE，该ID对应为实例的InstanceId，可调用[ListInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html）接口获取该参数的值

ResourceType.description_en: The resource type. The value is fixed as INSTANCE

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the classification and grading template

TemplateType.description_en:
The type of the classification and grading template. Valid values:

INNER: a built-in template.
USER_DEFINE: a custom template
TemplateType.description_zh:
分类分级模板类型。取值：
INNER：内置模板。
USER_DEFINE：自定义模板

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned if the request failed

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值说明如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
